descriptors.R: nominee of the party of the administration in office since 2001; a sitting senator from a Western state
descriptors.D: nominee of the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 2006 elections; a first-term senator from a Midwestern state

compile_desc.R: the party of the administration in office since 2001
compile_desc.D: the party that has held a majority in both houses of Congress since the 2006 elections

others_line: Other candidates on some ballots, including an independent, a Libertarian, a Green and a Constitution party nominee (answer "other").
never_name: McCain, Obama, Palin, Biden, Bush, Cheney, Hillary or Bill Clinton, Huckabee, Romney, Edwards, Nader, Bob Barr or McKinney

slice_sources.men: 2008 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2008; men who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2008 (interpolated between their 2004 and 2010 estimates)); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2008 returns.
slice_sources.women: 2008 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2008; women who are citizens 18+ (the native_white, naturalized, black and other slots) less those barred for a felony conviction (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2008 (interpolated between their 2004 and 2010 estimates)); outside the eleven former Confederate states; turnout and choice calibrated to the certified 2008 returns.
slice_sources.south-white: 2008 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2008; white non-Hispanic adults in the eleven former Confederate states (US-born in the native_white slot; white naturalized citizens sit in the naturalized slot), less felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2008 (interpolated between their 2004 and 2010 estimates)); calibrated to the certified 2008 returns.
slice_sources.black-south: 2008 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2008; US-born Black adults in the eleven former Confederate states, all citizens with no legal bar beyond felony disenfranchisement (Sentencing Project / Uggen et al. state estimates for 2008 (interpolated between their 2004 and 2010 estimates)), which falls on them disproportionately; calibrated to the certified 2008 returns.
slice_sources.immigrants: 2008 American Community Survey (1-year, IPUMS) aged to November 2008; noncitizen adults (the alien slot), who cannot vote in federal elections; naturalized citizens are counted in the naturalized slot and can vote.

masks: the nominee of the congressional majority party
